Keep the change minimal and idiomatic; do not rename or restructure anything else.

- First run `cd /echo && go build ./... && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -40` to record the baseline (note which tests fail before your change).

Investigate, reproduce, and fix minimally.

1. Read /echo/group.go fully, plus /echo/echo.go (`Echo#Add`, `Echo#Use`, `applyMiddleware`) and /echo/router.go (`Add`) and /echo/group_test.go (do NOT edit tests).

3. Implement the minimal fix.
